edge.label: ~100 TOPS edge
edge.note: Serial single-thread bound. Detector is the gate; PnP chain 0.77ms + rewind 0.45ms are negligible next to the detector forward pass.

cpu_upper_bound.label: laptop CPU (UPPER BOUND)
cpu_upper_bound.note: Serial single-thread bound. Detector is the gate; PnP chain 0.77ms + rewind 0.45ms are negligible next to the detector forward pass.

feasibility_verdict.bottom_line: Compute permits >30 Hz ONLY on edge HW (edge p90 ~61 Hz cap); CPU is capped at ~8.0 Hz and cannot even sustain 30 Hz. BUT cadence is NOT the binding constraint: even infinite cadence floors the DEBIASED in-plane 1-sigma at ~0.106 m (>0.05 m), and the RAW (real, biased) error never drops below ~0.30 m at any cadence. More fixes do NOT close the gap.
